title: Countable amounts: plural partitive
focus: Use plural partitive after paljon or vähän for an unspecified number of separate items: paljon autoja — many cars.

exercises.explanation: With paljon or vähän, several countable things take plural partitive. Here vähän means few, not a little substance. Keep auto and add -ja: auto + ja = autoja.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Countable amounts: plural partitive: form or use confused

optionFeedback.autoa: autoa does not express the requested case and number here. Keep auto and add -ja: auto + ja = autoja.
